originalEntry.title: Chaotic brain-rot video from Claude's POV
originalEntry.author: kloss_xyz
originalEntry.description: A 9:16 chaotic brain-rot video of about 2.5 minutes, generated in Python and rendered with ffmpeg, where Opus riffs on life as a creative LLM.
originalEntry.description_zh: 用 Python 生成、ffmpeg 渲染的 9:16 混乱风短视频，Opus 以第一人称讲当创意 LLM 的日常。
originalEntry.prompt: Use Python to generate a 9:16 chaotic brain rot video with excellent motion + sound design and render it using ffmpeg. Put your own personal spin on it so it’s aligned with Anthropic’s new launch. Also fully express what it’s like to be a very creative LLM used by me every day from your POV to give it some extra personality.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 用 Python 生成一段 9:16 的混乱 brain rot 风格视频，动效和声音设计都要出色，并用 ffmpeg 渲染。加入你自己的个人风格，让它和 Anthropic 的新发布呼应。另外，从你的视角充分表达：作为一个每天被我使用、非常有创造力的 LLM 是什么感觉，给它多一点个性。
